### A House Divided
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-may-26-2017.html
Passage: 1 Timothy 2:1-2
Points:
- Political hostility, dishonesty, and internal strife threaten to tear society apart.
- God commands Christians to pray for their governing leaders, regardless of political agreement.
- Mockery and malicious attacks tear down a nation, while prayer and blessing build it up.
- The true solution to moral decay is found only in Jesus Christ, not political parties.
- A faithful Christian witness and spiritual renewal hold the key to societal healing.

### Christ Our Mediator
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christ-our-mediator
Passage: 1 Timothy 2:5-6
Points:
- Sinners cannot approach a holy God on their own and require a go-between.
- Old covenant priests and animal sacrifices were temporary and could not permanently remove sin.
- Jesus Christ serves as the only mediator because He is both fully God and fully man.
- By offering Himself as a ransom, Christ made complete atonement for all who believe.
- Because Christ continually intercedes for His people, believers can approach God with confidence.
